description: Test suite for scheduling and interval calculation functions in the Mattermost plugin API, including tests for wait interval calculations, rounded intervals, and job scheduling concurrency.

methods.name: TestMakeWaitForInterval
methods.description: Tests the MakeWaitForInterval function for various interval and last finished time scenarios.

methods.name: TestMakeWaitForRoundedInterval
methods.description: Tests the MakeWaitForRoundedInterval function for various interval, current time, and last finished time scenarios.

methods.name: TestSchedule
methods.description: Tests the scheduling function for single-threaded, multi-threaded single job, and multi-threaded multiple jobs scenarios.
